header: THE RULES FOR A NEW OR CHANGED PAX LINE (step 64a; my request, 31 Oct 2026). PURE. PAX number: always five digits, always starting with 4. Department: required. Location: may be empty (the table then shows "Office"). Plain words only: letters, digits, spaces and & - – — ( ) . , / ' + # : I run these rules again on the server whatever the panel did; the panel runs them only to tell the person early.
